descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B10 · P1 · 已知

病历在另一个标签页开着时，那一页的自动保存或 Save & Extract 会把快速口述分配进来的文字整段覆盖掉

票：TFA-92582 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev

注：就是早上 dev 报告里的「会丢数据」第 1 条

思路 / Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S16 「放框时病历开在一个过期的浏览器标签页里：它的自动保存和它的 Save & Extract 都不会抹掉放好的文字」 Chart open in a stale tab while boxes are placed: neither its autosave nor its Save & Extract erases the placed text

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 3；TFA-92582 steps 2-3）
  • U7 Assigning does not create tasks, record medication events, or generate a note. Those happen only when the physician opens that patient's Encounter tab and taps Save & Extract.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 7）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given QA Hosp Patel (415) with encounter note 'Cross-cover: febrile overnight.'; tab 1 on Patel's Encounter tab

When In tab 2 place 'Bed 415, afebrile since 4 am.' with Link; in tab 1 (no reload) replace the notes with what tab 1 shows plus ' Seen at bedside.', wait 3 s, reload. Then in tab 2 place 'Bed 415. Recheck BMP in the morning.' with Link; in tab 1 (no reload) tap Save & Extract, reload

Then Patel's note holds the old note, both placed boxes and the words typed in tab 1; Save & Extract in the stale tab does not erase the second box (or the app visibly refuses to save stale text)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: cp2 mustContain 'Cross-cover: febrile overnight.', 'Bed 415, afebrile since 4 am.', 'Seen at bedside.' (U2: appended text stays on the note). cp3 mustContain 'Cross-cover: febrile overnight.', 'Seen at bedside.', 'Bed 415. Recheck BMP in the morning.' (U2; U7: Save & Extract works from the chart, it must not wipe what was placed). …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U30；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S16 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92582 ready for qa

如果一个病人的病历在另一个标签页里开着，这时把快速口述的框分配给这个病人，那个标签页的自动保存或 Save & Extract 会把分配进来的文字从 encounter 里冲掉。

If a patient's chart is left open in another tab while Quick Dictation boxes are assigned to that patient, that tab's autosave or Save & Extract wipes the assigned text from the encounter note.

依据：dev U30 (ledger #30). Already dev report §2 #1 (data loss): the backend encounterNotes ends with only tab 1's text. Linking without a stale tab works (U19).

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
